core_details.description: The Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT) will improve I-80 between 1300 East and 2300 East. The pavement will be replaced with new concrete throughout, and a new lane will be added to eastbound I-80 between 1300 East and 2300 East. Expect lane shifts and lane closures between 1300 East and 2300 East and minor delays in the area during the project.

US-89 in Davis County will be:
widening U.S. 89 to three lanes in each direction.
adding interchanges – bridges over U.S. 89 with on/off ramps – at 200 North/400 North, Oak Hills Drive, Gordon Avenue and Antelope Drive;
and adding bridges over U.S. 89 at Nicholls Road and Crestwood Road.

The Utah Transit Authority (UTA) is building a new BRT system in Ogden that will run from the FrontRunner Station, through downtown Ogden, down 25th Street to Harrison Blvd., through the Weber State University (WSU) campus and to McKay-Dee Hospital. A section of the BRT line runs along Harrison Blvd. between 25th and 37th streets. BRT stations will be built on Harrison Blvd. at 28th, 32nd and 36th streets. *HARRISON BLVD NIGHT WORK: beginning Sunday, June 5 and continuing through late June, Harrison Blvd. will be reduced to one lane each direction in work zones between 31st and 37th streets Sunday through Thursday from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. nightly to facilitate waterline work. Harrison Blvd. construction will continue through summer 2023.

The Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT) is rehabilitating pavement and improving shoulders in several areas on State Route 24 (S.R. 24) between Torrey and Hanksville. New guardrail and drainage features are also included in the project. In total, the project will involve improvements to approximately 23 miles of roadway.
This project will improve overall user safety for the traveling public and extend the service life of the two bridges on I-70 over I-15 just southwest of Cove Fort.
